# Third-party notices

The `NOTICE.txt` files identify the material included by FloatLib. License texts
and source headers are copied from upstream.

[retained-material.json](retained-material.json) lists files and their notices;
[SOURCES.json](SOURCES.json) records the sources and hashes of the license texts and headers.

| Material | Notices |
| --- | --- |
| CORE-MATH binaries and source excerpts | [CORE-MATH](licenses/core-math/NOTICE.txt) |
| OpenLibm binaries and LGPL test excerpts | [OpenLibm](licenses/openlibm/NOTICE.txt) |
| Release RLIBM provider, BSD-2-Clause | [RLIBM](licenses/rlibm/NOTICE.txt) |
| Ecosystem RLIBM-ALL provider/logs, MIT | [RLIBM-ALL](licenses/rlibm-all/NOTICE.txt) |
| FPBench copied FPCore fixture | [FPBench](licenses/fpbench/NOTICE.txt) |
| Verificarlo Dockerfile/workflow copies and source excerpts | [Verificarlo](licenses/verificarlo/NOTICE.txt) |
| FLiT databases, serialized configurations, source excerpts | [FLiT](licenses/flit/NOTICE.txt) |
| Daisy source excerpts, including Leon inheritance | [Daisy / Leon](licenses/daisy/NOTICE.txt) |
| FPTaylor source excerpts; separate interval-library excerpts | [FPTaylor](licenses/fptaylor/NOTICE.txt), [OCaml interval](licenses/ocaml-interval/NOTICE.txt) |
| ReproBLAS source excerpts | [ReproBLAS](licenses/reproblas/NOTICE.txt) |
| ExBLAS source excerpts and Agner Fog compatibility-patch excerpts | [ExBLAS](licenses/exblas/NOTICE.txt), [Vector Class GPL-3.0-only](licenses/vectorclass/NOTICE.txt) |
| Short Intel TBB and glibc diagnostic excerpts | [TBB](licenses/tbb/NOTICE.txt), [glibc](licenses/glibc/NOTICE.txt) |
| Original IBM FPgen records and derived streams | [IBM](licenses/ibm-fpgen/NOTICE.txt) |
| Current and archived Conway reader adaptations | [Conway attribution](licenses/conway/NOTICE.txt), [full Apache-2.0 license](licenses/conway/LICENSE) |

Redistribution permission for the IBM test vectors remains unverified.

- [Test source archive](archives/test-source.md)
- [Benchmark public source archive](archives/benchmark-source.md)

Keep the applicable notices and license texts with copies of these files or archives.
